completionSentence: 사용자는 찾은 파일의 정리 결과를 변경 전에 확인하고, 충돌 없는 동일 저장장치 이동만 실행하며, T5는 중간 crash를 실제 파일 identity로 재조정하고 exact plan으로 원래 위치를 복원한다.
qualified: Discovery and planning move, rename, overwrite and delete zero user files.
A preview shows bounded source, destination, already-there, collision and unsupported cross-volume facts.
Any destination collision blocks every move before the first filesystem change.
Apply requires a reversible backed-up local-change declaration and revalidates source identity, empty destination and same-volume atomic rename.
The durable plan records each completed move; restart reconciliation recognizes a moved inode without replaying the rename.
Rollback revalidates the moved file and empty original location before restoring it with the exact durable plan.
T5 internal state, credential roots and canonical path aliases remain outside the candidate and destination surfaces.
notClaimed: Overwrite, delete, hard-link, symlink or automatic final-version selection
Automatic folder taxonomy inferred without user purpose
Large batch performance beyond the bounded 12-file plan
Document reconciliation, standardization or new deliverable creation
next: Bind selected source files, calculations and generated deliverables in one provenance receipt before opening document reconciliation and standardization.
